title: Feminist groups call for march against gender-based violence in Paris

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against gender-based and sexual violence, coinciding with the week of the International Day for the Elimination of Violence…
tea.want: Organisers demand a comprehensive law against violence toward women and children, including a dedicated budget for its implementation.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Organisers confirmed the march will start at the Panthéon at 14:00 and proceed to Place d'Italie.

summary: Feminist collectives NousToutes and Grève féministe have called for a demonstration in Paris on November 28, 2026, to protest against gender-based and sexual violence. The march is part of a wider series of mobilisations across France. In Paris, the protest is scheduled to begin at the Panthéon at 14:00 and conclude at Place d'Italie. The event is supported by numerous organisations, unions, and political parties, including Attac, Solidaires, FSU, Amnesty International France, the CGT, La France insoumise, the Socialist Party, and the Communist Party. Protesters are advocating for a comprehensive law and increased funding to combat violence against women and children. A separate march is also planned in the city on the same day to condemn gender-based, social, and state violence.
demands: Comprehensive law against violence against women and children
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Sortiraparis reported the march is scheduled for November 28, starting from the Panthéon.
Basta! confirmed the route from the Panthéon to Place d'Italie and noted the involvement of various political and social organisations.
